title: An ant tunnel in damp soil, 1,200 frames after it was cut
question: Both beds are the same excavation in the same soil, one unit of water over field capacity — the state the lab's bed reaches within a few hundred frames of anything being planted in it. Does either read as a nest an ant lives in?
context_md: burrow_probe arms=damp, seed 1, frame 1200. The shaft, gallery and chamber are carved and lined exactly as creature::line_burrow lines them (367 wall cells worked into packedsoil in BOTH arms, so this is not a digging difference). The only thing that differs is the moisture at which a worked wall gives way: SOIL_FIELD_CAPACITY, which is where drained ground rests, against a new SOIL_WATERLOGGED half-way up the drainable band. Gallery open at frame 1200: 0 of 180 for one arm, 180 of 180 for the other; the losing arm is 100% caved by frame 5.
